messages:
olivia: hey team — first day! quick question: where should I post small things vs policy/permission requests? examples: asking for a temporary GCP role, ordering a monitor, lunch run signups, or bot invites (calendar/github). thanks! :wave:
saira: welcome, olivia :smile: for quick social/lunch stuff use #lunch-plans or #random, not #general. for access requests go to #help or #eng-oncall depending on the team.
peter: +1 to that. for infra/GCP roles specifically ping #eng-infra and add @eng-infra on the thread. include your org email and the role you need.
onboarding-bot: Hi Olivia! To speed up onboarding, please complete the New Hire checklist: https://intranet.redwood/c/onboarding. Once done, run `onboard verify` in DM with @devex to trigger access grants.
mike: for hardware, people-ops coordinates swaps — mention @people-ops and file a request in the people-ops channel with a photo of the current seat setup if you need a replacement.
people-ops: hey! to request a monitor or peripherals, please fill the New Equipment form (link in pinned messages in #people-ops). we can do same-day pickups for downtown offices.
elaine: bot invites: you can try `/invite @calendar-bot` in the channel you want it in. if that fails (permissions), mention @devex and we'll ask platform to approve. for github access, open a ticket in #help with repo list and your manager cc'd.
devex: tiny tip — prefix access requests with `[ACCESS]` so they filter into our automation. e.g. `[ACCESS] GCP:storage-admin for olivia@redwood.com — expiry 30d`
olivia: awesome, this helps a ton. one followup — are permissions typically temporary (30d) or permanent?
saira: usually temp for trial periods; if it's long-term, manager requests permanent in the ticket. we try least-privilege by default.
peter: if you're unsure which channel, default to #help and add a note like "cc: #eng-infra". avoids dropping sensitive stuff in #random.
mike: also feel free to DM me or @elaine for any fast equipment needs — we do short Slack threads for logistics.
olivia: thanks everyone! copying checklist link and will run onboard verify now. :raised_hands:
